description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers grounding a brand decision against the corpus (archetype, voice, colour, naming, archetype->type). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: UI style grounding (design-intelligence), token authoring (design-tokens), generating a logo asset (logo-generation), validation of emitted artifacts (brand-consistency), and font-pairing lookup without a brand frame (typography-system style path).

queries.q: which brand archetype fits a rugged outdoor gear company?
ground the voice and tone for a challenger fintech brand
what colour direction does the corpus suggest for a children's education brand?
which naming pattern suits a coined-word tech startup brand?
what type pairing-filter does a luxury law firm archetype imply?
which UI style and palette fit a fintech dashboard?
queries.note: frontend style grounding → design-intelligence, not brand strategy

queries.q: emit the brand colours as DTCG CSS variables
generate a logo image for this bakery
queries.note: asset generation → logo-generation, not brand grounding

queries.q: check whether this landing page copy is on-brand
what's a good serif font pairing for a magazine?
queries.note: font-pairing lookup with no brand frame → typography-system style path
